correctness.rationale: All moving prime-five cycles have one of precisely six 5-letter line itineraries (neighboring line labels distinct). Their affine orthogonal-projection returns strictly contract, giving one candidate per itinerary. The two type-I words have a negative choice-gap factor for every h>0; type-II words require h<1 but then a later gap is strictly negative. Type III has five exact positive-gap inequalities equivalent to alpha<h²<beta: alpha and beta are the unique positive roots of P(u)=u^5-12u^4-10u^3-20u²-15u-8 and R(u)=u^6-22u^5-u^4-52u³-17u²-22u-15, respectively. Exact root brackets are 12<alpha<13 and 22<beta<23; endpoint ties are stationary under the stated convention. Both mirrored cycles have multiplier -(u-1)^3/(u+1)^4 of absolute value below one. Independently enumerated six word candidates at 11 rational heights. The universal theorem follows from the exact sign argument, not the finite checks.
